mapper.select: SELECT id,buyer_id,vendor_id FROM t_orders WHERE id=#{orderId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id,nickname,avatar_url,city,performance_score,star_avg,star_count,deal_count,carrier_verify_status,buyer_verify_status,carrier_tier,invite_tier,user_role,created_at,phone FROM t_profiles WHERE id=#{uid} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT id,status FROM t_support_threads WHERE kind='peer' AND order_id=#{orderId} AND ((user_id=#{uid} AND peer_id=#{peer}) OR (user_id=#{peer} AND peer_id=#{uid})) ORDER BY last_message_at DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_support_threads SET status='open',last_message_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='closed'
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t_orders o WHERE o.status!='cancelled_user' AND ((o.buyer_id=#{actor} AND o.vendor_id=#{target}) OR (o.vendor_id=#{actor} AND o.buyer_id=#{target}))) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t_trips t JOIN t_demands d ON d.matched_trip_id=t.id WHERE t.owner_id=#{target} AND d.publisher_id=#{actor}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t_reviews rv WHERE rv.target_id=#{target} AND rv.reviewer_id=#{actor}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t_trips t JOIN t_orders o2 ON o2.trip_id=t.id WHERE t.owner_id=#{actor} AND o2.buyer_id=#{target}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
